verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail (Virtual Mail) offers automation-adjacent features such as automatic labels, junk filtering, APIs and an MCP server, so asking whether automations can be versioned and rolled back is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review, or rollback of automations or rules. The API scope docs explicitly note no changelog and no sandbox or test mode, and API versioning is not automation versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
